summary: Monster model instance: a polymorphic object with two embedded model nodes (each with its own vtable), the pattern resource, two render nodes, the bounding box and four state vtables. Monster_Model_Create allocates the single-pattern form (0x164 bytes); Monster_Model_CreateDualPattern allocates the dual form (0x2DC bytes) whose layout covers every field here.
evidence: Monster_Model_CreateDualPattern allocates 0x2DC bytes with Mem_AllocAligned_2 and stores vtable 0x00780A20; Monster_Model_Create allocates 0x164 and stores 0x007808B4. The batch size 4884 came from a mistyped self: Monster_Model_BuildFromRecord/BuildDualPattern take a MonsterActor, so their 0x125C/0x1310 accesses are not this class. The batch base Text_Layout is also wrong - no base constructor is called.
